title: WfGg Radar V6.24 internal mail Outbox and isolated Messenger pilot
problem: Allow Radar to prepare internal Last War player-to-player mail drafts while preserving the production Radar READ-ONLY invariant and keeping every Last War write capability outside Radar.
goals: Preserve Radar production Last War mode as strictly READ-ONLY.
Model the offline-proven Last War 1.0.351 mail.send contract for private player mail without executing mail.send.
Provide a durable local Outbox with DRAFT, QUEUED and CANCELLED states, anti-duplicate handling and revision history.
Install the dry-run Messenger Outbox binary only under /opt/wfgg-messenger-pilot for the VPS pilot.
Keep wfgg-radar-connector, radar-native-template and Radar Sentinel unchanged throughout the Messenger pilot.
Run a local DRAFT -> QUEUED -> HISTORY probe with no game connection, no token and no Last War mutation.
Keep private cross-server mail blocked while its official-client behavior remains unproven.
non_goals: Do not send a real Last War internal mail during V6.24 dry-run qualification or VPS pilot.
Do not add a Last War write path to the Radar Connector.
Do not stop, restart or replace wfgg-radar-connector during the isolated Messenger pilot.
Do not pause Radar Sentinel for the isolated Messenger pilot.
Do not use or persist a Last War token for Outbox operations.
Do not enable private cross-server mail.
Do not promote V6.24 to production without a separate explicit human approval.
Do not authorize a future write-capable Messenger sender through this pilot approval.

current_change.purpose: Qualify the non-sending Radar internal-mail Outbox and isolated dry-run Messenger runtime before any production promotion decision.

acceptance_criteria: The protocol contract remains mail.send on SFS with MAIL_SELF_SEND=21 for same-server private mail.
The exact request fields remain name, title, contents, allianceId, targetUid, sendLocalTime, type, optional serverId.
The Outbox accepts same-server DRAFT creation and transitions DRAFT -> QUEUED with replayable history.
Active duplicate drafts are reused instead of duplicated.
The installed Messenger pilot binary SHA-256 matches the immutable published pilot artifact.
The Messenger pilot runs only from /opt/wfgg-messenger-pilot.
Production connector and native-helper SHA-256 values are identical before and after install/probe.
Radar service stays active and Radar Sentinel stays active/enabled throughout the pilot.
The runtime probe reports GAME_CONNECTION=NONE, GAME_SCAN_EXECUTED=NO, NETWORK_SEND=NO and LASTWAR_MUTATION=NO.
The one-shot pilot approval is revoked after the pilot.
Production promotion requires a separate explicit human approval.
architecture_invariants: GitHub stores code, branches, CI and release/pilot artifacts.
ChaCha DEV on ChaChaVPS is the governed runtime orchestrator.
ChaChaNas remains authoritative persistent storage for project data and backups.
VPS is runtime-oriented and not the authoritative durable project store.
Radar remains Last War READ-ONLY; any future write-capable Messenger must remain a separate component.
Producer and verifier responsibilities remain separated.
